panels.description: Mean of the snarkos_consensus_block_latency_secs histogram: the gap between two on-chain block header timestamps, recorded once per block committed through consensus. Read off the chain's own clock, so it is quantized to whole seconds. Compare with `Avg Block Time /per min`, which measures the same thing off the scraper's clock.
panels.title: Consensus Block Latency
Avg Block Time /per min
panels.description: Seconds per block derived from how fast the height gauge advanced between scrapes. Read off the scraper's clock, so it is not quantized, but it is averaged over the rate window and counts blocks gained by syncing from peers, which makes a node catching up look faster than the chain is. Compare with `Consensus Block Latency`, which reads the chain's own timestamps.
